Document Output and Delivery: Implement and configure Continia Document Output and Document Delivery to meet customer requirements for document generation, formatting, distribution and communication. Expense Management: Implement and configure Continia Expense Management, including expense types, policies, approval workflows, payment methods, user setup and mobile application processes. Requirements and Solution Design: Gather, analyse and validate customer requirements, translating business needs into practical, supportable solutions aligned with standard product functionality and agreed project scope. Testing and Issue Resolution: Plan and coordinate testing of standard functionality, integrations, updates and approved customisations. Project Coordination and Communication: Work closely with customers, Project Managers, developers, support teams and other consultants to coordinate activities, communicate progress, manage dependencies, escalate risks and issues, and control changes to agreed scope. Go-Live and Transition to Support: Prepare customers for go-live, support implementation cutover activities, resolve implementation-related issues and facilitate a smooth transition into business-as-usual operations. Working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, including core finance processes, system configuration and integration points. Understanding of purchase-to-pay processes, accounts payable, purchase invoice processing, document distribution, approval workflows and employee expense management. Experience of delivering software implementations through requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, training, go-live and transition to support. Ability to translate business requirements into practical, supportable solution designs that meet customer needs. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage professionally with stakeholders at all levels, including Directors and senior management. Strong documentation, presentation, workshop facilitation and customer training skills. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, including the ability to analyse data and support implementation activities. Ability to manage competing priorities, maintain composure under pressure and work effectively both independently and as part of a wider project team. Proven ability to build effective working relationships, manage customer expectations and communicate technical information in a clear, accessible manner. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured, quality-focused approach to implementation delivery. A proactive approach to identifying risks, resolving issues and escalating matters appropriately. A valid UK driving licence and willingness to travel to customer sites across the UK when required. Desirable Knowledge of Continia Document Capture, Document Output, Document Delivery and Expense Management, or demonstrable experience with comparable document automation, invoice processing or expense management solutions. Experience of integrating finance applications with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and/or Eque2 Evision. Knowledge of finance and accounting processes within the construction industry and related sectors. Familiarity with software development, release management, testing and change control lifecycles. Experience of working with implementation methodologies, project governance and formal project documentation. Relevant Microsoft Dynamics, Business Central or Continia product certifications.
